long_biography.plain_text:
OmniAccess began as a small Palma-based team applying IT support and connectivity expertise to remote marine operations. Rita Grima and Bertrand Hartman created the company around managed communications, networks and later cybersecurity, with Grima providing financial direction. The combination of technical systems and recurring service relationships turned a local specialist into a broader maritime digital-solutions platform.

Marlink acquired a majority stake and ultimately became OmniAccess's sole shareholder, separating the founders' original wealth-creation story from the company's present ownership. Grima's current identifiable business role sits instead at Investments Sankara 2018, a holding company established to own and manage investments, where Spanish commercial records name her president and chief executive. The role places her current work in investment governance rather than executive management of the business she co-founded.
